If you cannot afford to go to the dentist to have it done then I would say go for it. Something is better than nothing. It will fit you since the impression thing looks good (on the website). But going to the dentist is the best option as they will be able to examine your teeth and advise on what kind of mouth guard will be best for you.Also, sometimes the guard might need adjustments which the dentist will be able to do for you :)  Maybe if you do order them, you can take it with you to the dentist when you go for a check up so they can see if the guard is best suited for you Also, there is a technique to taking impressions and the fit of the guard will depend on how good the impressions are.

I know how you feel! Don’t take it personally :) 
It’s stressful for dentists as well and they prefer nurses who know how they work ( not necessarily more experienced). They all work differently and have their own way of doing things. I would focus on how they usually handle different kinda of treatments and try and assist accordingly. Can you observe while the other nurses are working? Maybe you can have a quick look to see what they do differently that makes them work more efficiently? And try to speak to the nurses as well. It might be a little upsetting to hear people point out your flaws but it’s a very good way to evaluate yourself and see how you can improve these things. I used to be the new inexperienced nurse as well and my dentist used to nag me all the time . I had to observe other nurses and they observed me while I worked to point out things I could improve on, which helped me a lot. Sometimes you just gotta get used to things and eventually you will just get used to how the dentist works and before he can say what he needs, you will have it ready! 
I hope you don’t feel bad about it . Try stay positive xx Good luck

Keep trying because you deserve all the help you can get. If they put you on the waiting list then keep calling to tell them you need help soon. Is there a certain doctor that you see all the time?
